newsitem.title: USA: Tobacco stocks rise on anticipation of settlement.
newsitem.headline: Tobacco stocks rise on anticipation of settlement.

text.p: Tobacco stocks rose on Thursday amid anticipation by investors that liability settlement talks could soon yield an agreement, traders said.
In Washington, negotiators for state governments and cigarette makers were struggling to resolve contentious issues and reach a landmark settlement of tobacco-related lawsuits by the end of the week.
Philip Morris Cos. Inc. topped the New York Stock Exchange's most active list, rising 2-3/8 to 52-week high of 47-7/8 by midafternoon. RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp jumped 1-1/4 to 35-3/4.
American Depositary Receipts of B.A.T Industries Plc , parent of Brown & Williamson Tobacco Corp, rose one to 19-7/8.
Loews Corp, parent of Lorillard Tobacco Co, gained four to 106-3/4.
UST Inc, parent of smokeless tobacco maker United States Tobacco Co, tacked on 3/4 to 30.
